name: Katya
self_text: Hey there! I'm Katya, a German mid‑twenties guy who loves baking sourdough and spends a lot of time in the kitchen. Right now, programming is my main focus, and I thrive when I study independently—nothing beats quiet, deep work. I actually do best with complete silence while working, so I keep my headphones on and let the world fade away. I’m happy to connect either in person or online, depending on what works for everyone. Most weeks I can chat or hang out on Sunday afternoons. If you’re into coding, quiet study sessions, or just want to swap sourdough tips, let’s talk!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a step‑by‑step walkthrough session. I'd strongly prefer that you are into programming, but I won't rule you out over it. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with occasional short exchanges, though it's not a requirement. Nice if you are available Sunday afternoon.
